name: PUT mapping with duplicate dynamic template names emits a warning

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.6.0-1a31626ddad62ae3c1a07b57de9d38993688a143 "Dynamic template [my_template] in index [test_dup_templates] is defined more than once.
